english.note: Use this for the everyday joint-injury sense, such as wrenching or spraining an ankle.
Use 扭傷 when twisting or bending a body part causes an injury, especially a sprain.

examples.english: I accidentally wrench my ankle while playing football.
examples.traditional: 我踢波嗰陣唔小心扭傷咗隻腳。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tek3 bo1 go2 zan6 m4 siu2 sam1 nau2 soeng1 zo2 zek3 goek3

examples.english: It's easy to twist your ankle playing football.
